function.name: uber_eat_order
function.description: Place an order for food delivery on Uber Eats by specifying the restaurant and the items with their respective quantities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

restaurant.description: The name of the restaurant from which to order food.

items.description: A list of food item names selected for the order.

quantities.description: A list of quantities for each food item, corresponding by index to the items array.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t give you the current temperature in Moscow right now. You can quickly check the latest weather in Celsius by:

1. Visiting a weather website such as [weather.com](https://weather.com) or [accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com).
2. Using a weather app on your phone (e.g., the built‑in Weather app on iOS/Android).
3. Asking a voice assistant (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) with a query like “What’s the temperature in Moscow?”

These sources will give you the most up‑to‑date Celsius reading.

We can approximate or say we can't fetch real-time. We can suggest using a weather API. But we can also provide a placeholder. According to policy, we should not hallucinate. So we should say we cannot provide real-time data. We can suggest how to get it.
